8424.summary: Ultimate General: Gettysburg is a Tactical Battle Simulator that allows you to lead thousands of soldiers in the famous Battle of Gettysburg as commander of either the Union or Confederate army. The game features the most accurately created map, complex morale, innovative control mechanics and smart AI. You have the freedom to use different strategies while the battle progresses. Your decisions and military performance play a crucial role in the result. Lead your army and win the Battle of Gettysburg!

27324.summary: The Gardens Between is a surreal puzzle adventure through memory, moments and time that follows best friends, Arina and Frendt, as they fall into a mysterious world of beautiful garden islands. The player can traverse back and forwards in time to discover each garden's secrets and, along the way, reveal a story about friendship, childhood and growing up.
27324.storyline: Arina and Frendt are two childhood friends who live next door to one another and share a treehouse built on a small garden square between their homes. On a rainy night, the pair sneak away to their hideout, and a glowing sphere of light appears before them, sweeping the treehouse into a vast, dreamlike ocean scattered with small islands. Each island is a garden that represents a cherished moment from their friendship, from the day one of them first moved in to the afternoon they built the treehouse together. Wordlessly, the two make their way through these surreal gardens, carrying a lantern and coaxing light toward glowing portals at the summit of each one. Rather than a straightforward journey, their passage bends time itself forward and backward, letting them relive and reshape their shared memories. Told entirely without dialogue, it is a tender meditation on friendship, nostalgia, and the moments that bind two people together.

34324.summary:
Come and play at the Pretty Girls Casino!
Select from 16 sexy girls for your poker battle.
Featuring popular Texas Hold'em rules.

similar.name: Monster Musume: Everyday Life with Monster Girls Online
The Game of Life: DX Jinsei Game IV

39724.summary: This is pretty simple game. It includes bombs, flags, and boxes. Do not detonate the bombs. Click boxes to open it. Put flags on the box if you believe there is a bomb there.

114724.summary: The rhythm of nature is in danger! You are Áilu, a young Sámi whose ordinary reindeer herding day turns into an adventure. Learn the old ways of the Noaidis, Sámi Healers. Harness the powers of the Noaidi Drum and the Familiar Spirits to fight against a disorder spreading across the land!
114724.storyline:
The daily life of a Sámi village is disturbed after an accident at a nearby Tar-Burning Pit. An odd disease starts spreading across the area, affecting everything from the land to the people and animals.

You play as Áilu, a young Sámi herder searching for a runaway reindeer doe. The mystery of the growing disorder starts to unravel when Áilu finds an old enchanted drum, Goavddis. Time is running out for the infected, but the long lost knowledge of Sámi healers, Noaidis, is still beating within the drum.

121524.summary: Explore strange and wonderful islands and dark labyrinths below in this narrative puzzle platformer. Guide young mechanic Mo on her quest to repair a world on the brink of collapse. The powerful Omni Switch at your disposal may not be enough to fix the damage that hides beneath the surface...
121524.storyline: You are Mo, a skilled tinkerer, living with her family on a pastoral archipelago, once inhabited by an ancient race of inscrutable giants. Their otherworldly but vital machines, festering in the underbellies of the islands themselves, must be kept going or an almost ever-present threat will swallow all. Mo vows to restore the hidden engines in time, but is this truly what she needs?

similar.name: The Missing: J.J. Macfield and the Island of Memories

123824.summary: Escape to a world of wonder as you enjoy a magical twist on classic Solitaire! Clear cleverly designed puzzle boards and uncover a gorgeous fantasy realm on your journey of relaxation and fun!

similar.name: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch

125624.summary: The world is a vast, beautiful and dangerous place – especially when you have been shrunk to the size of an ant. Explore, build and survive together in this first person, multiplayer, survival-adventure. Can you thrive alongside the hordes of giant insects, fighting to survive the perils of the backyard?
125624.storyline:
In Grounded, players are shrunken to the size of an ant and tasked with surviving in the unique micro-world of a suburban backyard. Players must gather, craft and build bases with everyday objects found within the yard, searching for life-saving resources and living alongside giant, peaceful insects while fighting to survive massive hostile inhabitants.

Grounded provides a mix of environmental and narrative driven story telling. Set in a versatile, handcrafted sandbox structure it allows players to create their own experience from the ground up. Tasks that may seem approachable when human-sized become a challenge in this dangerous backyard landscape. This familiar yet fantastical world can be navigated solo or in four-person co-operative multiplayer, where players work together to complete missions or explore the intricately detailed world.

similar.name: Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin
The Dark Pictures Anthology: Little Hope

129624.summary: Bone marrow is a role-playing Board puzzle game. For a certain amount of time, combine the figures, increase your characteristics and deal with evil, but keep in mind that a wrong step can lead to irreversible consequences!
129624.storyline:
The "2048" traditional version proposes to combine numbers in pairs. The meaning of the Bone Marrow game has not changed but the numbers have been replaced with objects, and using their combination, you can create better weapons, shields and potions, which will lead to an increase in your attack and defense. In addition, monsters appeared; having done away with which ones, you will replenish your account. Such seemingly simple changes allow to significantly revive the familiar puzzle, and give it a completely different look.
Bone Marrow is suitable for those who prefer turn-based missions rather than the endless movement of elements on the field. Here, on each card, you need to score a certain number of points, afterwards, you can switch to a new one. It all is arranged as a journey to different places of the Middle Ages that should be cleared from evil creatures.

129724.summary: Sleeping with a possessive half-dragon becomes the least of Sable's worries as he tries to stay one step ahead of his domineering mother-in-law.

similar.name: Burrow of the Fallen Bear: A Gay Furry Visual Novel

133424.summary: Immerse yourself in Andrew's story and feel the pressure of being a sniper. Find and eliminate the target in the crowd before he runs away.In living environments, designed exclusively for this fantastic game, you will not have a second chance, precision is everything!
133424.storyline: After troubled events, Andrew reflects on the direction of his life and the consequences of his career. His senior officers had planned a "rest" time for Andrew, but he was assigned to a secret division where he will have to carry out missions for the good of his country and deal with the ghosts of his past.

134324.summary: A tropical open-world adventure. Climb, glide, swim, and sail your boat around a beautiful archipelago in this physics-driven sandbox. Use Tchia's special ability to take control of any animal or object you can find, and Jam on your fully playable Ukulele. A game inspired by New Caledonia.
134324.storyline:
Tchia's special gift lets you take control of any animal or object you can find. Use their unique gameplays and abilities to travel, solve puzzles and uncover secrets. Fly around as a bird, explore the ocean as a fish or dig treasures as a dog. Over 30 playable animals and hundreds of objects.

Jump and glide your way across a vast archipelago and use the Tricks system for cool stunts and dives. The free climbing mechanic lets you ascend anything in the world without restriction including any physics-driven tree. Sail your customizable boat on turquoise lagoons and dive around coral reefs and shipwrecks.

144724.summary: In this story-driven 3D platformer, explore Sephonie Island's massive cave network, and link with unidentified species using the novel Puzzle Grid system. Explore the island's depths as shipwrecked biologists Amy, Ing-wen, and Riyou, whose personal histories come to bear on the shifting spiritual landscape of the island depths.
144724.storyline:
In the near future, three biologists are on a joint research trip to use their ONYX implants to research the creatures of the uninhabited Sephonie Island. However, a mysterious phenomenon destroys their ship, leaving them shipwrecked.

Amy Lim, Taiwanese-American and bold leader, hails from the midwestern USA town of Bloomington. Riyou Hayashi, an analytically-minded Japanese-Taiwanese researcher, calls the bustling Tokyo his home. And Ing-wen Lin, a kind and considerate Taiwanese scientist, lives in Taipei.

The trio will find their motivations and loyalties put to the test as they navigate Sephonie’s caverns, facing not only rocks and creatures but also their deepest memories and dreams. As they grow more intimate with each other and the island, an ancient force, brewing deep in the island's abyss, may threaten their newfound relationship, and the world...

145424.summary:
Rogue Mansion is a survival horror game combined with the best of the roguelike genre! Explore a procedurally generated mansion that changes every time you play, and becomes more dangerous and unpredictable according to your level of fear.

Experience the game in different ways, by choosing from multiple unique characters, each with their own equipment, specialist perks, and motivations.
145424.storyline:
In the fading light of 1999, the peaceful streets of Greenhart City were shrouded in darkness. On its outskirts stood the majestic Rogue Mansion, an opulent residence once inhabited by the esteemed couple Lazarus and Catherine Rogue. Known for their power, wealth, and influence, they were the pillars of the community. However, tragedy struck when Catherine succumbed to an incurable illness, leaving Lazarus broken and consumed by grief. Overcome by despair, Lazarus chooses to end his own life within the mansion's grand walls.

Now, months later, unexplained disappearances, strange sightings and disasters centred around the mansion have begun gripping the city. Nobody who has ventured inside to investigate the link has returned. The people of Greenhart need a hero.

152124.summary:
Bramble: The Mountain King is a grim adventure set in a world inspired by dark, Nordic fables.

Explore the beautiful yet dangerous and twisted land of Bramble in your endeavour to rescue your sister. Traverse a wondrous landscape and survive deadly encounters with Bramble's many hideous creatures.

Not everything in Bramble is exactly how it seems - in this strange land with creatures big and small, you must be careful when to approach and when to hide. Many hungry and spiteful beasts lurk in these forests and caves. Watch your step....
152124.storyline:
A shy boy and his adventurous, older sister sneak out from their home at night and wander deep into a nearby forest. As they explore an old ancient ruin, the ground suddenly collapses, and they tumble down through a sinkhole to the lost and magical world of Bramble.

Together, they explore Bramble, and befriend curious and strange spirits. However, not all of the creatures that they meet are friendly. The siblings are taken by surprise as a huge troll traps them. The troll abducts the sister, leaving the younger brother lost in despair.

Without his older sister and role model, the shy boy is lost. He needs to find strength inside of him and grow up fast in order to face all the horror and monsters ahead of him. When he embarks on this journey to reunite with his sister, he also unravels a dark curse that has sickened the world. He soon realizes that something dangerous is lurking in the shadows below the mountains.

153824.summary:
Experience ridiculous fun in this cross-platform multiplayer, free-roaming game! Drive monster trucks, tanks and more amazing vehicles across a huge open world. Level up, play events, earn cash, unlock new cars and discover secrets.... Crash Drive is back!

COMPETITIVE EVENTS
Destroy a gigantic beach ball, catch robbers as a cop or steal the king's crown, these are just a few examples of the 10 fun game events this game has to offer. Participate in these random competitive events, beat your opponents to earn the most cash and buy awesome new cars or customisations.

CRAZY CAR LEVELING
By using nitro boosts you increase the car’s nitro capacity, by driving at top speed you increase its top speed... catch the drift? ‘Maxing’ all stats for a car increases your player level allowing you to buy new cars or customisations. Collect over 50+ vehicles and customise your car with funky antennas, boosts and unique number plates with your in-game name on it. Reach the maximum player level to prestige and show who is the real Crash Drive 3 boss! Solid golden car anyone?

OPEN WORLD EXPLORATION
To the moon and back! Drive around freely and explore the boundless and varied open world at your leisure. Fly a rocket to the moon, storm the king’s castle in the forest, go to the saloon in the wild west canyons or experience ice drifting fun in the arctic snow. Done with icy cold? How about a relaxing ferry trip to the tropics? Each area is unique and filled with secret areas, collectibles…

154024.summary: A souls-like action-RPG with lots of battles and exploration. Defeat your enemies, steal their weapons, and uncover the secret of the stronghold.
154024.storyline:
The story takes place in an old stronghold, at the last days of a great battle. You died, but your will was stronger than your body, so you woke up again, to continue the siege in a never ending night.

Remembering little more than your purpose, you'll have to leave the dungeons, advance through the stronghold's outskirts, and reach the most high tower. To find the Heir and end your curse.

similar.name: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree

161224.summary: Word game is literally a game of words. Player controls "I" to find clues between lines, delete words to change the meaning of sentences, or shift words to rewrite facts. “I” must be wise and brave enough complete the mission of words. May the best "I” win!

165124.summary: Chess Gambit transports you to a low-poly environment where castles, tough soldiers, battle-hardened knights and loyal bishops are the true stars. Use your best strategies to open a path and conquer the castle of your opponent's king!

166824.summary: Play a third-person, story-driven game set in alternative Russia of the late XIX century where religious visions clash with harsh reality. INDIKA tells the story of a young nun who sets off on a journey of self-discovery with the most unusual companion by her side, the devil himself.

similar.name: AI: The Somnium Files - Nirvana Initiative

172024.summary: Johnny Turbo needs to clean up Paradise, a cyber city overrun by augmented minions under the cult control of the world's most advanced AI, Syn, who's looking to expand to world domination if not stopped here and now. Wall-running, Hero-Time, chain saw leg augments, flying cars and lots of booms. Fight to purge Syn with five new augments, dual chainsaw arms and a second chainsaw leg in the final episode, part 1.

188424.summary: The cute fantasy visual novel, "How to Sing to Open Your Heart" returns as a remastered version. Princess Myana, who loves to sing, finally comes to Eroolia. A lot of people, like the Imperial Guard Captain, Ludovic, and Princess Anna, are unhappy about it. What will happen?

similar.name: The Choice of Life: Middle Ages 2

193624.summary: Play either alone or with a friend on this cute adventure game!

similar.name: Irony Curtain: From Matryoshka with Love
Bud Spencer & Terence Hill: Slaps and Beans 2

199324.summary: Cross the threshold of Fort Boyard and complete the challenges! Take up the challenge with more than 10 activities that combine Action and Party Games! Endurance, dexterity, and perseverance will be your best assets for collecting boyard coins.

200724.summary:
Join BIG B on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump!
Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

204124.summary: Your favourite explorer, Tad Stones is back! Embark with Tad and his friends on a new journey through different cities where you will encounter challenging puzzles in your quest to get the emerald tablet.

204524.summary: Grab your best bud for help in this new co-op challenge to help two adorable penguins, Bread and Fred, reach the top of the snowy summit. Time your jumps, cling to walls and swing across gaps to see how far you can make it before you tumble all the way back down the mountain.

204624.summary: Ereban: Shadow Legacy is a fast-paced stealth platformer game where you become Ayana, the last descendant of a forgotten race. Harness mystical shadow powers, high-tech gadgets and avoid or kill to uncover the truth about your past and the key to saving a dying, morally grey universe.
204624.storyline: Ereban: Shadow Legacy is a fast-paced stealth platformer game where you become Ayana, the last descendant of a forgotten race. Harness mystical shadow powers, high-tech gadgets and avoid or kill to uncover the truth about your past and the key to saving a dying, morally grey universe. What will your legacy be?

similar.name: Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara

207724.summary: Use physic powers in Atama to see through the eyes of your pursuers to avoid detection as you investigate a cursed rural Japanese village. You can't fight back; you must rely only on your powers and your wits to avoid your enemies. Inspired by Forbidden Siren and Junji Ito.

210624.summary: Bounty Star is an over-the-shoulder 3D action game that marries mech combat and customization with farming and base building. The player takes on the role of a broken but powerful ex-soldier named Clem, a war veteran, talented fighter and expert mech pilot.

210924.summary:
Join BIG P on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump!
Enjoy the colourful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

211024.summary: As punishment for her transgressions, Ingrid is sent to hell. As she struggles through the darkness that hungers to consume her heart, she makes her way toward redemption. Her fate is in your hands.

similar.name: Irony Curtain: From Matryoshka with Love

211624.summary: When a greedy megacorp with the power to enter storybooks takes over Flynt Buckler’s fairytale world, he must get a job to sabotage them from within! Climb the corporate ladder, fight in stylish, snappy combat, and dive into storybook worlds from Lovecraft to sci-fi in this genre-bending RPG!
211624.storyline:
When Flynt Buckler, a classic fairytale adventurer, storms the castle of his evil dragon arch-nemesis Tinder, he finds the once intimidating fortress has been converted into… corporate offices? The villainous dragon is nowhere to be found and her castle is full of mindless coffee-sipping, report-filing drones. What happened?

It turns out that storybooks are an untapped market ripe with valuable resources, cheap labor, and profit to be had—so naturally, real-world conglomerate Ever After Inc. found a way to intervene! With Tinder’s Castle as their new corporate headquarters, Ever After Inc. is hellbent on taking over every storybook they can. With no choice but to get a job, Flynt Buckler must team up with his former nemesis Tinder in order to climb the corporate ladder and take down Ever After Inc. from the inside!

216624.summary: Kriegsfront Tactics is a procedural turn-based mecha tactics RPG set in alternate 1970s during an era of conflict in Southeast Asia where you'll play as a commander of a mecha squad sent behind enemy lines. Build your mecha squad, complete missions, and survive the front another day.
216624.storyline: Set in alternate 1970s during an era of conflict in Southeast Asia, you'll play as a commander of a mecha squad sent behind enemy lines. Manage your squad, resources, and mechs. Complete missions, and survive the front another day, while facing hard decisions that will test your morality.

similar.name: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch

217424.summary: It is a block breaker with a gauge type power-up system. The player's ship can always fire a shot, which, combined with the power-up system, makes it an aggressive block breaker. The difficulty level can be adjusted depending on the ship, so it can be enjoyed by both beginners and experts.

similar.name: Nights of Azure 2: Bride of the New Moon

217624.summary: Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name is a 2023 action-adventure video game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. It is a spin-off of the Like a Dragon series. Taking place during the events of Yakuza: Like a Dragon (2020), Like a Dragon Gaiden focuses on the series' original protagonist, Kazuma Kiryu, as he embarks on a new adventure in Osaka under the guise of a secret agent.
217624.storyline: Having faked his own death to protect his foster children, the legendary former yakuza Kazuma Kiryu now lives in the shadows, his identity erased. Bound by a pact with the secretive Daidoji faction, he operates as one of their covert agents under the codename "Joryu", carrying out assignments in exchange for anonymous support of the orphanage he holds dear. Between jobs, he seeks quiet moments of meditation, trying to leave his violent past behind. But that fragile peace cannot last. When Kiryu is tasked with providing security for a smuggling operation in Yokohama, the job turns out to be a trap, as an unidentified group of yakuza ambushes the agents. Recognized despite his hidden identity, Kiryu is dragged back into a dangerous new conflict that threatens to unravel the very secret keeping his loved ones safe.

228524.summary: Explore the corners of a surrealistic post-human world to give life on Earth a second chance in this touching story about sacrifice and hope.
228524.storyline:
Play as Gaia, the Spirit of Life, and navigate stunning platforming environments in an abstract world to salvage the souls of extinct animals. Revive these creatures after learning their final fate: the last whale harpooned, the final eagle caged, the last deer hunted down, and more, while you survive encounters with dangerous, oil-covered Devourers that roam the wasteland in search of remaining life.

In this emotional journey from the creators of the critically acclaimed Arise: A Simple Story, you alone can restore life to the planet.

233624.summary: Race through caverns while blasting away enemies and terrain to reach the depths of Mars in this reimagining of the 1981 classic.

236124.summary: In "The Traveler's Path", you have to help the character reach his destination by swapping and rotating the pieces of the path. The pieces need to fit together correctly to form the perfect path. Test your thinking and logic skills in this challenging puzzle game.

243924.summary: Unveil a heartfelt story of family, dinosaurs, and UFOs! Craft, upgrade, and survive in a realm of primeval predators, savage tribes and... ancient aliens. Rise from a humble cave dweller to the planet’s last hope — alone or in local co-op. Welcome to the dinovania!
243924.storyline: Embark on a thrilling journey as you follow the gripping tale of a cave dweller fighting to protect his family. Survive a brutal T-Rex attack and uncover a narrative blending the wild with intriguing sci-fi twists. Forge unexpected alliances as you unravel the truth behind an alien presence.

244024.summary: Having been a blockbuster, Dynablaster is a game for the strategic thinker whose smart tactics will instill fear in his competitors – playing online or local against others or against the computer. In this captivating action game, destroy your enemies with cleverly placed bombs.

246424.summary: Defend the earth from incoming asteroids. Hit asteroids to destroy them. Survive the Waves.

249324.summary: Join private investigator Jack Pepper on a guns blazing, jazz-fueled adventure in MOUSE: P.I. For Hire. MOUSE combines the charm of hand-drawn rubber hose animation inspired by the classic cartoons of the 1930’s with the adrenaline and action of an explosive first person shooter.
249324.storyline: Meet Private Investigator Jack Pepper, once a war hero, now a detective in a world where danger lurks in the smallest mouse hole. His journey starts with a seemingly cliché damsel in distress, but as P.I. Pepper begins to scratch the surface of Mouseburg’s seedy underbelly, his journey for justice quickly spirals into a complex web of intrigue, involving murder, corruption, and the unlikeliest of enemies.

273624.summary: This game combines roguelike-style deckbuilding with SRPGs to create an all-new experience! Follow Vel as she leads the Clausewitz Battalion into battle against Fahftania and the Hellmuth Brigade. Collect 50 different cards to build the strongest deck and fight enemies on a map shrouded in mist.

similar.name: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden
The Seven Deadly Sins: Grand Cross

278124.summary: In a realm between life and death, a confused soul, haunted by a life filled with misguided choices, seeks redemption and freedom.

278824.summary:
The Witch’s Bakery is a 2D Adventure Puzzle game where you play as a joyful witch who opens a bakery in modern Paris.

She has a special power: she can heal emotions with her bread.

279624.summary: Hang out and get lost with close friends in a big world. A cooperative online walker-talker from the creators of Untitled Goose Game.

283024.summary: A port of Rally Cross, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

similar.name: D1 Professional Drift Grand Prix Series

291924.summary: It's a fun 2D jumping game for kids as well as for adults. The game takes place in an enchanted forest full of witches. Your mission is to collect as many coins as possible and get out of there.

293324.summary:
The "Professional Baseball Spirits" series is a professional baseball game that pursues realism.

The first home game, "Professional Baseball Spirits 2004,'' was released on March 25, 2004. "Professional Baseball Spirits 2015" introduces 3D scanning technology that photographs professional baseball players from 360 degrees and reproduces them three-dimensionally.

Furthermore, we have also adopted laser scanning technology that measures the precise shape of the stadium, allowing you to enjoy a realistic baseball experience with overwhelming expressiveness.

296724.summary: Extinction Rifts is a fast-paced FPS where you get stronger as your combo increases! Inspired by classic shooters, you will battle your way through secret enemy headquarters and destroy the Ancient Monoliths with your devastating gauntlet!

305224.summary: Shoot paint, mix colors, and solve puzzles in this adventure about friendship and redemption. Just don't enter that portal to another universe, and everything will be perfectly fine.

305624.summary: Gather and lead your army to the finish line! Face your enemies and win the battle!

314424.summary: "Faaast Penguin" is an action-packed racing game where up to 40 penguins compete in a chaotic race to the finish. Players can unleash attacks, ride on ultimate rides, use shortcuts, and outpace rivals to reach the finish line first.
314424.storyline:
You’ve never been on a vacation like this――
Heading for an extravagant dinner, penguins collide in a knockout race. TAKEOFF!

317124.summary: Fate Trigger is a 3D Anime-style, hero-based tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Dive into a dynamic world of floating islands, become a sharpshooter with extraordinary special skills, craft your own strategies, and engage in thrilling, spectacular life-or-death showdowns!
317124.storyline:
A massive, powerful spherical entity hangs high in the sky. The world is fragmented into floating islands, threatened by a spreading Paleblight disaster that can destroy the battlefield at any moment. You are the chosen warrior, the Awakener, and your mission is to uncover the deep-seated secrets of this new world by shooting your way to ultimate victory.

Fight solo or team up as you venture into aerial battlefields. Scavenge and craft the best weapons, unleash your shooting prowess and special abilities to dominate your opponents.

Are you ready to embark on epic battles and write your name across the sky?

319324.summary: Master the Universe and Defeat the Invasion!

328724.summary: Merge, strategize, and conquer—reach 2048 in this addictive puzzle phenomenon!

similar.name: Wood Cube Block: Classic Casual Puzzle
Family Jigsaw Puzzle: Classic Mosaic Puzzles

329124.summary: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

329724.summary: Hard difficulty TPS roguelike with randomly generated dungeons. The protagonist, Willow Martin, has no memory of her past, but when a fight begins, her body moves naturally and she displays exceptional combat abilities.

similar.name: Nights of Azure 2: Bride of the New Moon
Sweet Home: Look and Find - Collector's Edition
Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest

334024.summary: Embark on an epic journey through five mystical forest worlds to save Princess Kara and show the world that the true hero lives in each of us.

337024.summary: The story of apprentice detective and Devil Summoner extraordinaire Raidou Kuzunoha XIV returns in this remastered classic! Call upon your demons to solve supernatural mysteries and dispose of enemies.

similar.name: AI: The Somnium Files - Nirvana Initiative

339624.summary: It's 1977. Henry Gray awakens in a psychiatric hospital, haunted by the ghosts of his past. Fire and Ashes await: An immersive survival horror where nothing is certain, insanity and reality mix, and voice recognition means every monster will hear you scream - within the asylum and beyond…

348924.summary: Monkaru is an orthodox, retro-inspired turn-based fantasy RPG where you travel to defeat The Demon Lord with the help of a girl who was sealed in a crystal. The game is by Experience with character designs by Yuji Himukai and monster designs by Akifumi Yamamoto.
348924.storyline:
The Demon Lord—a wicked being who appeared in a world of sword and sorcery.

It is said the Demon Lord commanded legions of monsters, and there were even towns that fell to his might. Many heroes rose to challenge him, but not one returned alive.

And so time passed…
The people of the world waited for another who would rise to face the Demon Lord again. And then, in a town where adventurers gathered, one finally appeared.

A new hero, destined to set off on a fateful journey.

similar.name: Mercenaries Blaze: Dawn of the Twin Dragons
Re:Zero - Starting Life in Another World: The Prophecy of the Throne
The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel IV
Wizardry: Tale of the Forsaken Land

349524.summary: Peak is a cooperative climbing game for up to four players. After crash-landing on an unknown island, players take the role of scouts attempting to ascend the mountain at its center. The mountain is semi-procedurally generated and changes every 24 hours, featuring five distinct biomes with unique obstacles and enemies. Players manage stamina, collect climbing tools like ropes and pitons, and must work together to survive hazards while ascending.
349524.storyline: A group of scouts crash-lands on a mysterious island with no way to call for help. Their only hope of rescue lies at the summit of the massive mountain rising from the island's center. As they begin their ascent, the scouts discover they are not alone. A menacing figure known as the Scoutmaster stalks anyone who strays too far from the group, and the mountainside is teeming with hostile creatures that grow more dangerous the higher they climb.

359424.summary: This expanded version of Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout adds new story content, playable characters, and gameplay features. The game tells the story of Ryza and her friends as they discover alchemy and explore the secrets of their island.

similar.name: Nights of Azure 2: Bride of the New Moon

374524.summary: Take control of a flying saucer in this retro-style arcade game inspired by classic UFO legends. Circle around grazing cows with your beam, abduct them for fuel, and rack up massive combos! With low-poly 3D visuals and a nostalgic 90s vibe, this game is simple, addictive, and utterly out of this world.

similar.name: The Angry Video Game Nerd: Game Over 2

376924.summary: A retro-style action-platformer that blends the stealth shootouts of Rolling Thunder with the raw brawling of Double Dragon. The result? A thrilling 2D spy adventure set in the 1960s — packed with fists, bullets, and classic arcade energy!!

378924.summary: Stonebound is an infinite game type where Char jones gets trapped in an ancient temple after trying to steal the precious treasure of the place. With a click on the joystick button, help the character to change his direction to avoid the falling stones.

388624.summary: Mote: Workshop is a short, atmospheric story game set in a forgotten woodworking shop, where every tool, plank, and dust mote carries the echo of a father who spoke more through his craft than his words. Explore the dimly lit space at your own pace, interact with worn tools and scattered plans, and piece together a quiet narrative about memory, family, and the comfort of focused work. With simple controls and a cinematic first-person view, Mote: Workshop invites you to slow down, listen to the creak of the floorboards, and find meaning in the small details left behind on the bench.
388624.storyline:
The shop always smelled the same—sawdust, old varnish, and the faint trace of machine oil that never quite left the air. As a boy, he used to sit on a crooked stool near the window, watching his father work in steady silence. Words were rare there; instead, his father spoke through careful measurements, patient sanding, and the quiet rhythm of a plane gliding across wood.

Now the tools rest where they were last set down, as if waiting for hands that won’t return. Running his fingers along the worn workbench, he can almost hear that familiar cadence again—tap, scrape, breathe. In the stillness, he realizes the shop was never just a place to build things. It was how his father showed love: not loudly, but in every joint cut true, every surface made smooth enough to last.

389724.summary: Forest Escape: Last Train is a co-op horror exploration game for 1-4 players in the mysterious forest. Repair your locomotive, solve the insane Warden’s eerie puzzles, and outrun the stuff of nightmares as you try to escape this twisted realm.
389724.storyline: You're a prison escapee trapped deep in a misty forest. But this isn't just about getting out – you're travelling through the fractured mind of a crazy Warden. His madness has transformed reality into a surreal horror world. Death isn't enough for him. He wants to break your spirit. Start the train, hold on tight, and ride into the nightmare. The only way out... is forward.

394524.summary: Step into the city's shadows as defenders against the paranormal. Your mission: Contain the Phasebound Horrors, the manifested fictions encroaching upon our world and the survival of humanity.

Explore Bluey’s world like never before in Bluey's Happy Snaps!

Join Bluey and her family in a new photo-powered adventure game. Discover familiar locations, play with loads of toys, and use Bluey's camera to capture and keep all your favorite moments.

396224.summary: In a world consumed by darkness, a lone warrior rises against the forces of evil. Face monstrous creatures, survive brutal battles, and forge your legend in a retro-flavored action fantasy.

402824.summary:
C.A.B.A. (Center of Anomalies of Buenos Aires) is Hypnos Team's interpretation of the subway level in the Backrooms universe, a short, first-person survival horror set on a ghost station that doesn't appear on any map. Presented as found footage, with retro game references and lighting that shouldn't work this well.
You can't fight what's down here. You can only try to escape. Inspired by genre classics like PT, Outlast, and Amnesia, C.A.B.A. focuses on stealth, exploration, and environmental puzzles. Includes full VR mode on Steam VR, Meta Quest, and PS VR2. Approximately 30 minutes long, with multiple endings.
402824.storyline:
You step off the last train of the night at Pirámides, a long-abandoned ghost station on Buenos Aires' Line H of the Subte. When you turn back, the exit is gone. The fluorescent lights flicker over empty tiled corridors that shouldn't exist — a subterranean liminal space looping back on itself, where every wrong turn takes you deeper.
Alone in the dark, you'll need to explore every corner of the station, piece together the fragments left behind by those who came before, and solve the riddles of this place to find a way out — before whatever shares it with you reaches the platform.

404724.summary: From the creators of Nidhogg, murder hordes of monsters in this 2D platforming autoshooter with a killer soundtrack. Collect Blood, gold, and bones to increase your powers. Can you survive the Blood Dungeon?

414224.summary: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

415224.summary:
Bubble Bobble was released by Taito in 1988 for an 8-bit home console.
This is an action game where Bub and Bob, transformed into Bubble Dragons, go on an adventure to rescue their girlfriends, Betty and Patty, who have been kidnapped by a wizard.
The game features 100 stages in total. What will happen if you clear Stage 100 and see the "True ending"...?

423924.summary: Drive and survive through a frozen post-industrial wasteland. Gear up your vehicle with different tools to tackle hostile threats, while scavenging for resources. Lead a small survivor camp while discovering the truth about what happened.
